label: Icons
when: a row of small icons: social network links, contact details or feature symbols
rules: One spectra/icon per icon; "icon" is a Font Awesome name without "fa-" (unknown names show nothing): phone,envelope,location-dot,clock,star,check,heart,truck,leaf,user,users,calendar,cart-shopping,gift,shield,award,handshake,lightbulb,comments,thumbs-up,camera,wrench,house,utensils,credit-card,recycle,bolt,globe,rocket,car,bicycle,paw,tag,facebook,instagram,linkedin,x-twitter,youtube,tiktok,whatsapp. "size" like "40px". Icons that mean something (social, contact) get "accessibilityMode":"svg" and an "accessibilityLabel". "linkURL" is "#" until the member gives the address: never invent one.
